name: Merrow
description: Fish-finned bipeds with spears who find Abigale in the stream and sign to her.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn merrow flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine when the Phyrexians attack the water.
timeline.quote: Many were forced to flee into the deepest parts of the Wanderwine.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor merrow escape to the Dark Meanders to wait out the invasion and adapt to their new environment.
timeline.quote: they escaped to the Dark Meanders, tunnels deep under the plane, hoping to wait out the invasion beneath the water.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: Fish-people armed with spears surround Abigale; their leader signs to her and invites her to come see something.
timeline.quote: We have something you must see

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The merrow tow Abigale into the depths of the Wanderwine.
timeline.quote: they began to swim toward the Wanderwine proper, towing Abigale along with them.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 4: Fetch Me That Flower" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Abigale explains that the merrow guarded the sleeping Eirdu and that it followed her back to the battlefield to fix the imbalance.
timeline.quote: The merfolk realized it was moving to fix the imbalances

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The valley was flooded and resettled by merrow.
timeline.quote: The valley was later flooded and resettled by merrow

citation.text: "Porringer Basin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: Merfolk who work as merchants and intermediaries and use glamers; aristocratic in Lorwyn and con artists in Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.
